authorExceptions.author: alonkarmona
authorExceptions.authorJustification: Live alert firing was attempted via start-alert-parity-batch and manual Graph PATCH variants (/beta/security/rules/detectionRules/{id}), which Microsoft Graph rejected with HTTP 400 BadRequest ('Custom Detection: Bad request') when enabling the ZPA Custom Detections in the lab tenant. The ZPAEvent parser body has been inlined into all 10 XDR Detections/*.yaml and Package/mainTemplate.json, all 10 Custom Detections are deployed and verified disabled via Graph readback (Evidence/receipts/graph-detection-deployment.json), abort-alert-parity restored all pairs to disabled state, and 10/10 query row parity is verified live across Sentinel Log Analytics and Defender XDR Advanced Hunting (Evidence/receipts/alert-parity-live.json).

authorExceptions.author: alonkarmona
authorExceptions.authorJustification: 7-dimension live alert parity depends on live Custom Detection alert generation (E2E-Q02), which Microsoft Graph rejected with HTTP 400 BadRequest when enabling ZPA Custom Detections in the lab tenant. Query-level row parity across all 10 detection pairs is verified 10/10 on live Log Analytics and Advanced Hunting (8 positive-row pairs matching 1:1 and 2 zero-row pairs accepted by DEC-ZPA-ZEROALERT-01; see Evidence/receipts/alert-parity-live.json), with all 10 XDR Detections inlining the ZPAEvent parser.

authorExceptions.author: alonkarmona
authorExceptions.authorJustification: Controlled alert parity state machine completion (complete-alert-parity) was aborted via abort-alert-parity after Microsoft Graph returned HTTP 400 BadRequest when enabling ZPA Custom Detections in the lab tenant. All 10 Analytic Rules and 10 Custom Detections were restored and verified in disabled state (enabled:false / isEnabled:false), and 10/10 live dual-surface query row parity is verified (Evidence/receipts/alert-parity-live.json).

authorExceptions.author: alonkarmona
authorExceptions.authorJustification: All 9/9 workbook queries in XDR Workbooks/ZscalerZPA.json (with ZPAEvent parser inlined as ZPAEventEvents) executed live with HTTP 200 and 100% row-count parity across Sentinel Log Analytics and Defender XDR Advanced Hunting (QUAL-RUNTIME-01 PASS; Evidence/receipts/workbook-queries-live.json). Seven of nine queries returned non-empty data (rows=[2, 2, 1, 6, 1, 1, 8]); the remaining 2 panel queries (WB-Q08 and WB-Q09) returned 0 rows on both surfaces for the shared lab dataset slice without runtime or schema errors.
